_readme: Hand-entered figures for Recounting the OOMs. Dates are 'YYYY-MM' (mid-month), 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a decimal year like 2024.5 (mid-year). Values: $B for money, GW for power, % for shares, hours for horizons. 's' lists source IDs from 'sources'. Edit on GitHub, commit, and the site rebuilds itself. Machine-fetched data (Epoch ECI, Epoch training compute, METR) lives in auto.json and is refreshed by the Update workflow.

claims.w: Training compute keeps growing about 0.5 OOM a year (about 3x)
claims.ev: The largest estimated run went from GPT-4 (about 2x10^25 FLOP, 2023) to GPT-6 Astra (about 10^27, Sep 2026): almost exactly 0.5 OOM a year.

claims.w: GPQA, the hardest test of 2024, falls within a generation or two
claims.ev: It fell within three months. o1-preview scored 78% on the PhD-level questions in Sep 2024, above the PhD experts OpenAI recruited; the frontier passed 90% in early 2026.

claims.w: By 2027, models outperform PhDs and the best experts in a field
claims.ev: On written expert tests, yes, since 2024-25 (GPQA, and company-reported scores near 98% on research-level math). On doing an expert's job unsupervised, not shown; see Agents.

claims.w: Labs hit the data wall, then find a way around it
claims.ev: Ilya Sutskever said in Dec 2024 that the industry had reached peak data. The way around was reinforcement learning on reasoning, which OpenAI first shipped in o1 in Sep 2024.

Underway early. METR's 50% time horizon went from 20 minutes (o1-preview, Sep 2024) to 3.4 hours (GPT-5, Aug 2025) to about 17 hours (Claude Mythos Preview, Apr 2026). The pace since 2024 is about 10x a year, versus about 3x before. The full drop-in remote worker is not here yet.

claims.w: A training cluster of about 1 GW around 2026
claims.ev: Sites: several reached about 1 GW in 2026, and xAI's Colossus 2 is expanding to 2 GW. Single runs: the biggest known one, GPT-6 Astra, drew an estimated 0.23 GW.

claims.w: AI investment near $500B a year by 2026 and $1T by 2027
claims.ev: Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta alone guided about $725B of 2026 capex; analysts project more than $1T for 2027.

claims.w: A tech giant reaches a $100B AI revenue run rate by mid-2026
claims.ev: Met in total, not as specified: OpenAI (about $40B) and Anthropic (about $65B) together passed $100B by August 2026. No tech giant reports AI revenue on this basis.

claims.w: Power for AI reaches about 5% of US electricity around 2026 and 20% by 2028
claims.ev: Now: all US data centers use about 4.5%. Official outlooks put them at about 9-17% in 2030, far below his path. Power is the binding constraint he predicted.

claims.w: AGI, an AI that can do an AI researcher's job, by 2027
claims.ev: Cannot be scored yet. At observed rates, his two leading indicators reach his marks between mid-2027 and 2028; see the two clocks above.

claims.w: A government AGI project by 2027 or 2028
claims.ev: Early moves only. The Genesis Mission order (Nov 2025) uses Manhattan Project framing but commits no new funding. In June 2026, US export controls led Anthropic to suspend access to its newest models from 12 June; the controls were lifted 30 June and access was restored 1 July.
DeepSeek published its own reinforcement-learning reasoning method in Jan 2025, four months after o1. Nvidia's current outlook assumes no data-center compute sales to China.
METR's long-task suite was near its ceiling by early 2026, GPQA is above 94%, and OpenAI reports 97.6% for GPT-6 Astra on FrontierMath Tier 4 (company-reported).
